risk_summary: The disclosure clearly indicates severe liquidity stress: all processors were idle, operations were suspended, and the company required a capital infusion or asset-sale advances to resume. Although it provides meaningful historical production, expense-reduction, impairment, and financing figures, future recovery depends on uncertain processor sales, licensing discussions, oil prices, and financing. Repeated forward-looking disclaimers and extensive strategic narrative partially dilute the severity of the immediate operating and going-concern risks.
